text:
Anika: kicking off a config-only change to smooth late-afternoon tails. no model artifacts. change-id cfg-2026-08-15-1. plan: canary 3% for 60m, then hold. keys: routing.spread=even->adaptive_smooth, batch.window_ms 15->10, tenant_limit_factor=1.00->0.95, token_timeout_ms 30000->31800. DeployBot: queued config-only deploy cfg-2026-08-15-1, canary=3%, window=60m. monitor: https://console.redwood/changes/cfg-2026-08-15-1
Lucas: quick check after 7m: small p95 uptick ~+13% on a narrow set of canary hosts. batching p50 3->1.7. snippet: ```batch.hist p50=3 -> 1.7; p95_ms=190 -> 215``` Zoe: that tracks — smaller window reduces coalescing. recommend pinning top 3 high-QPS tenants to prev config during observation. Anika: agree, pin prod-core, analytics-main, search-io to cfg-prev. DeployBot: pins applied: prod-core,analytics-main,search-io -> cfg-prev (action cfg-2026-08-15-pins)
Nikhil: adding auto-rollback: trigger if errors > 0.6% OR p95_delta > 28% sustained for 9m. DeployBot: rollback rule attached to cfg-2026-08-15-1: errors>0.6% OR p95_delta>28% for 9m -> AUTO-ROLLBACK OpsBot: alert created (page if errors>3x baseline OR sustained p95_delta>40% for 15m) -> https://ops.redwood/alerts/11002
Lucas: after pins, pinned tenants stable; canary cohort p95 delta down to ~10%, errors 0.03%. I suggest shrinking canary to 1% and extending to 90m for broader stability checks. Anika: ok reduce canary to 1%/90m, annotate change doc with keys and pin list and a brief cost note. DeployBot: canary adjusted to 1%/90m by Anika. change doc updated: "routing.adaptive_smooth; batch.window_ms 15->10; tenant_limit_factor 1.00->0.95; token_timeout_ms 30000->31800; pinned prod-core,analytics-main,search-io; rollback rules attached; canary 1%/90m"
Zoe: add runbook snippet for rollback in the change doc: ```1) curl -X POST https://deploy.redwood/api/rollback -d '{"change_id":"cfg-2026-08-15-1"}' 2) validate pins: GET /config/pins -> ensure listed tenants are on cfg-prev 3) notify #eng-sre and #product 4) watch p95/errors for 30m 5) escalate/incident if errors>1% for 10m``` Nikhil: please also add an expected cost blurb: "small per-token increase expected on high-concurrency tenants due to less batching". OpsBot: canary at 1% stable after 14m: p95_delta ~9%, errors 0.02%. next update in 26m. Anika: thanks everyone  — hold any unrelated routing/QoS merges until this finishes. if you see >0.5% errors or AUTO-ROLLBACK fires, call it immediate. reconvene after the observation window to decide morning ramp. :white_check_mark:
